say:0:1821337001:0.text: You seem to get along well with the ghosts here.
say:0:1821337001:0.source_cn: 墓园里这些鬼魂似乎对你的到来并不惊讶。
say:0:1821337001:0.male: You seem to get along well with the ghosts here.
say:0:1821337001:0.female: You seem to get along well with the ghosts here.

say:1:1821337002:0.text: That's because I come here often.
say:1:1821337002:0.source_cn: 是啊，因为我常常来此处拜访。
say:1:1821337002:0.male: That's because I come here often.
say:1:1821337002:0.female: That's because I come here often.
